name: m2c2kit
description: A library for cross-platform cognitive assessments

scripts.build-concurrent: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/build-helpers" && concurrently "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/core" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/cli" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/schema-util" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/data-calc" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/test-helpers" && concurrently "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/session" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/addons" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/physics" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/survey" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/db" && concurrently "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/schematics" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/embedding" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessment-grid-memory" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessment-symbol-search" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessment-color-dots" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessment-color-shapes" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessment-cli-starter" && concurrently "npm run build-webview -w @m2c2kit/assessments-demo" && concurrently "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessments-demo" "npm run build -w @m2c2kit/assessments-registry" "npm run copy-modules"
scripts.integration-test: docker compose down && docker compose build m2c2kit registry testapp testmodule --pull && docker compose build publish && docker compose up --exit-code-from m2c2kit
